policies.check: (((payload ->> 'tenant_id'::text) = 'PLATFORM_SECURITY'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'event_uid'::text) = (event_uid)::text) AND ((payload ->> 'accion'::text) = 'denegar'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'resultado'::text) = 'denegado'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'entidad'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['session'::text, 'scope'::text])) AND ((payload ->> 'motivo'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['NO_SESSION'::text, 'INVALID_SESSION'::text, 'UNKNOWN_IDENTITY'::text, 'SCOPE_DENIED'::text, 'ROLE_DENIED'::text, 'MSP_DENIED'::text, 'PLATFORM_DENIED'::text, 'RESIDENCE_DENIED'::text, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS'::text])))

policies.name: solicitudes_acceso_tenant
policies.check:
(((condominio_id)::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id'::text, true)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM visitas v
  WHERE (((v.visita_id)::text = (solicitudes_acceso.visita_id)::text) AND ((v.condominio_id)::text = (solicitudes_acceso.condominio_id)::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM casas c
  WHERE (((c.casa_id)::text = (solicitudes_acceso.destino_id)::text) AND ((c.condominio_id)::text = (solicitudes_acceso.condominio_id)::text)))))
policies.using:
(((condominio_id)::text = current_setting('app.tenant_id'::text, true)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM visitas v
  WHERE (((v.visita_id)::text = (solicitudes_acceso.visita_id)::text) AND ((v.condominio_id)::text = (solicitudes_acceso.condominio_id)::text)))))
